dedupe_keys.name: condition based maintenance of naval propulsion plants

description: The UCI Machine Learning Repository distributes condition-based-maintenance data generated with a numerical model of a frigate with a combined diesel-electric and gas propulsion plant. The provider describes simulator blocks for the hull, propeller, gas turbine, gearbox and controller, informed by similar propulsion plants. There are 11934 instances and sixteen measured-state features, with compressor and turbine decay coefficients as targets. Features include speed, torque, revolutions, temperatures, pressures, turbine injection control and fuel flow. Coverage is a simulated parameter grid, including vessel speeds from 3 to 27 knots, instead of observations from an identified operating ship. The data supports condition monitoring through prediction of degradation states. Text data files are listed and CC BY 4.0 terms are stated; reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that the source claim of agreement with possible real-vessel behaviour was not independently validated. The related simulator is described, but executable code and a separate model identity are not established here. No data or README files were fetched.
